title: Out-of-Hours Doctor in Berlin - FAQ
subtitle: The KV Berlin on-call practices, 116117 and the dental emergency service, checked on 24 October 2026.

items.q: When are the on-call practices in Berlin open?
items.a: From 1 October to 31 March: **Friday 15:00 to 21:00**, and **Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 9:00 to 21:00**, plus 24 and 31 December. From April to September they close at **20:00**. They are closed Monday to Thursday and every night after 21:00.

items.q: Who do I call when my doctor is closed on a weekday evening?
items.a: **116117**, the medical on-call service, day and night. Trained staff ask about the symptoms, a doctor can advise you on the phone, and if you are too ill to travel they send the **home visit service** to your flat.

items.q: Where are the on-call practices in Berlin?
items.a: Six for adults: **DRK Kliniken Westend, Vivantes Friedrichshain, Jüdisches Krankenhaus, Unfallkrankenhaus Berlin, Vivantes Neukölln and Charité Benjamin Franklin**. Five for children: **Westend, Sana Lichtenberg, Charité Virchow-Klinikum, Vivantes Neukölln (closed on Fridays) and St. Joseph Tempelhof**.

items.q: When should I call 112 instead of 116117?
items.a: Call **112** for anything that feels life-threatening: chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, heavy bleeding, a serious accident or someone who will not wake up. **116117** is for an illness you would normally take to your own doctor but that cannot wait.

items.q: Can a doctor come to my flat at night in Berlin?
items.a: Yes. The KV Berlin **home visit service** runs day and night for statutory and private patients who are too ill to get to a practice. You request it through **116117**.

items.q: What do I do with toothache at the weekend?
items.a: Use the dental emergency service: on Saturdays, Sundays, holidays and bridge days one dentist per district is on duty **9:00 to 12:00 and 15:00 to 18:00**, announced on **030 89004-333**, and two night sites run from **20:00 to 2:00**.

items.q: What should I bring to the on-call practice?
items.a: Your **health insurance card** and a list of any medicines you take. For a prescription after hours, the **Apothekerkammer Berlin** website shows which pharmacies are on night duty.
